messages:
maria-g: Noticed a cluster of failed SCIM deprovisions and some tenants reporting SSO failures after the RBAC rollout. Logs show saml binding mismatch and a hiccup in audit delivery.

sam-k: Can confirm. auth-proxy rejects assertions with binding HTTP-Artifact, while our SP is set to POST-only now. Example log:
```
ERROR auth-proxy: saml: binding mismatch expected=HTTP-POST got=HTTP-Artifact tenant=theta
WARN scim-worker: deprov enqueue tenant=theta svc_acc=sa-data cause=auth_failed
```

alex-r: Also saw audit-shipper restart during the same window; some service_account.role updates didn't reach audit-db. grep shows shipper SIGTERM at 1701234000 and resumed at 1701234200.

maria-g: Quick mitigation: enable tenant-scoped artifact fallback in auth-proxy and requeue deprovs for affected tenants. Also run backfill for audit events between 1701233800-1701234300.

oncall: I'm executing mitigations now and opening an incident. Commands: `./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenants theta,acme` and `./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1701233800 --end 1701234300`.

sso-bot: Patch 2025.4.2-authhotfix queued for canary. Will notify when health checks pass.

maria-g: Owners: Maria=backfill/requeue, Sam=auth-proxy toggle + PR, Alex=audit-shipper postmortem. Ping when mitigations complete and we'll schedule follow-up PM to harden RBAC rollout checks.
